name: Vanthorpe NeuralRoute Aug-Interface Bodysuit
description:
Matte obsidian with hairline gold-copper data traces visible under direct light, the NeuralRoute sits flush against the skin from ankle to throat. It is visually striking even fully clothed — the gold trace pattern is faintly luminous at chrome interface points. Cut for both standard and digitigrade lower-body proportions.

The fabric is nano-bonded in flat panels with zero bulk at seams. Port-open cutouts at standard neural, spinal, wrist, and ankle chrome sites are finished with conductive lip seals. Worn by people with serious augmentation loads who need clean power and data routing across multiple chrome installations without external cabling.
functionality: Routes power and data between up to twelve simultaneous chrome implant sites via integrated bus layer, eliminating exposed cabling between installations. Thermal dissipation weave manages heat from active chrome. BCI-addressable — the wearer can reroute data pathways through neural interface. Port cutouts self-seal around chrome hardware to prevent contamination ingress.
what_it_says: Your body is a system, and this is its wiring diagram.
worn_by: Spire-level executives with full chrome suites
high-end augmentation specialists who wear their work
manufacturer: Vanthorpe Systems (Tier 4-5 corponation, augmentation infrastructure division)
story_hooks: A NeuralRoute suit's bus layer can be forensically mapped to reconstruct exactly what chrome a person was running — someone very powerful doesn't want their aug load on record.
A Shelf-level hacker has built a pirated version from salvaged BCI flex-cable and transit card substrate — it works, but runs hot enough to burn if two implants fire simultaneously.
The gold trace pattern on a dead operative's NeuralRoute matches a proprietary layout that only one corponation's R&D division uses — they were running prototype chrome.

physical_description.visual_profile: Second-skin-tight bodysuit that clings from neck to ankles in matte obsidian black, with hairline gold-copper circuitry patterns that catch light like veins of precious metal running beneath the fabric. The tracery glows subtly at key points where chrome interfaces meet skin. Appears almost liquid in dim light, architectural and technical in bright light.
physical_description.fit: Compression fit, zero excess fabric, anatomically mapped to standard humanoid and digitigrade morphologies. Seams are molecularly bonded and invisible; the suit reads as a single unified layer rather than assembled panels.
physical_description.primary_material: Nano-bonded synthetic polymer composite with conductive copper-gold thread weave embedded at sub-surface level. Matte finish prevents reflective signature.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost frictionless to the touch; fabric has a micro-scaled texture that reduces static. Feels like high-grade athletic performance wear crossed with industrial biotech. Slight tackiness at conductive interface points.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte midnight black base with hairline gold-copper tracery in geometric, circuit-like patterns. Traces brighten to soft amber-gold luminescence at wrist, ankle, spine, and neural port cutouts under direct light or ambient chrome glow.
physical_description.closures: None visible — the suit is pulled on as a single unit. Port cutouts feature magnetic retention clips and conductive lip seals that lock chrome interface hardware in place.
distinctive_features: Strategically placed port-open cutouts sized for standard neural jack, spinal rig, wrist socket, and ankle coupler access
Conductive lip seals around each port that glow faintly when active
Hairline gold-copper data traces following biomechanical load paths visible under direct light
Zero-bulk seam construction with nano-bonded panel edges
Integrated thermal regulation microstructure (invisible but functional)
Ambidextrous wrist and ankle sizing to support both standard and chrome-limb attachment
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4-5 boundary — expensive augmentation infrastructure tech with working-class adoption. Signals serious chrome investment and technical sophistication, not wealth display.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmented laborers, chrome-heavy operators, and industrial workers in the GLMZ. Indicates commitment to body modification, technical competence, and integration into the augmentation economy. Street credibility among those with significant chrome. Associated with rigging, data-jockey, and heavy-mod subcultures.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; develops subtle wear patterns around port cutouts and heat-stress areas with use. Conductive traces may dull slightly from repeated chrome contact. High-end maintenance extends lifespan indefinitely.
